title: Gari (Homemade Pickled Sushi Ginger)
steps: Peel the young ginger and slice as thinly as possible, ideally with a mandoline.
Toss the ginger slices with ½ tsp salt and let stand for 5–10 minutes to draw out moisture.
Blanch the salted ginger in boiling water for about 1 minute. Drain and squeeze out excess water.
Combine all amazu ingredients in a small saucepan and heat gently until the sugar and salt dissolve. Do not boil.
Place the ginger in a clean sterilised jar and pour the warm amazu over it.
Let cool to room temperature, then seal and refrigerate for at least 1 day before serving. It will turn pale pink naturally.
tips: Young ginger turns pink naturally in the vinegar — no food colouring needed. If using mature ginger, blanch for 2–3 minutes. Keeps in the fridge for up to 1 month.
